description: Converts an item from a clone to a fully independent item.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

fields.description: Extra Sitecore field names to include, e.g. ['Title']. Ignored when full is true.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

id.description: The ID of the item to be analysed for clones presence. Supply this or path.

passThru.description: Returns the item that was converted from a clone.

path.description: The path of the item to be analysed for clones presence. Supply this or id.

recurse.description: Converts the whole branch rather than a single item.

name: common-convert-from-item-clone
